feature: Monitor metronome for rendered Preview and recording
implementation: TimelineEngine exposes Web Audio playback anchor/end/loop only; native Live owns its existing native clicks.
Preview hook waits for an actual playback clock and releases clicks on seek, stop or recording handoff.
Recording session owns clicks from its capture-pass anchor, beyond backing duration and during source-clock loops.
Ordinary recording-loop restarts replace the click using the new actual pass anchor; punch end truncates the click tail.
Stop, cancelled preparation and unmount release recording click nodes/timer.
No clicks are baked into backing/export buffers or connected to microphone capture inputs.
scope: Focused/regression runs overlap; counts are not a new full-suite total.
Native DSP/IPC implementations unchanged; full native tests from 0.13.20 are not claimed as rerun.
The browser uses real offline Web Audio and actual recording controller/worklets, a generated 317 Hz microphone and a synthetic prepared backing; native plug-in DSP is not requalified.
No new hardware listening, physical microphone/iOS or commercial plug-in acceptance.
No App Store/TestFlight upload or release tag.
limits: Web Audio scheduling uses bounded lookahead; stale beats after a UI stall are skipped.
Pathologically short loops are bounded to 128 click events and 256 scheduling windows per pump.
Recording count-in remains a delay in seconds, without count-in clicks.
Clicks are not digitally routed into input capture; the synthetic-input proof does not assess acoustic microphone bleed.
